name: guardrails
description: Guards for Claude Code tool calls: blocks destructive shell commands, asks before destructive git and settings edits, masks Bash reads of secret files, blocks the Read tool on them and asks before writes to them, blocks oversized whole-file Reads, and notes re-reads and retry loops.

disabled_guards.title: Disabled guard families
disabled_guards.description: Comma-separated families to turn off: pii, raw-client-data, session-url, egress, git. The core blocks (rm -rf of home or root, git push --force, dd, fork bombs) cannot be turned off.

allowed_email_domains.title: Your email addresses or domains
allowed_email_domains.description: Comma-separated addresses or @domains the egress guard treats as yours, such as @example.com. The domain of your global git user.email always counts.
